prompt: If Aisling (to have) one sleepy puppy, she would enjoy a quiet afternoon.
explanation_ru: Ситуация нереальна: у Айслинг пять собак, а не один щенок. Поэтому после if стоит Past Simple (had), а в главной части — would.

prompt: If everyone (to close) the fridge door, the milk would stay cold.
explanation_ru: Дверцу холодильника сейчас оставляют открытой, значит условие нереальное. После if нужен Past Simple (closed), а в результате — would.

prompt: Gianna would return the dress if the page (to work).
explanation_ru: Страница возврата сейчас не работает, поэтому условие нереальное. После if ставим Past Simple (worked).

prompt: If Mateus (to score) the winning shot, the team would cheer.
explanation_ru: Матеус на самом деле не забивает победный мяч — это мечта. Поэтому в if-части нужен Past Simple (scored).

prompt: Your lemon tree would die if you (to leave) it outside.
explanation_ru: Дерево ещё стоит в саду, и мороз — лишь нереальная угроза. После if нужен Past Simple (left).

prompt: The camera above Oleg's space does not work, so if it (to work), he could see who scratched his car.
explanation_ru: Камера сейчас не работает — условие нереально. После if ставим Past Simple (worked), а результат передаём через could.

prompt: Filip would catch the last line if his streaming (not / to buffer) at the ending.
explanation_ru: Стриминг сейчас буферит, поэтому ситуация нереальна. В if-части — Past Simple с отрицанием (did not buffer).

prompt: There are too many forms, so Piotr would finish sooner if he (to start) with the short guide.
explanation_ru: Пиотр сейчас не начинает с короткой инструкции, поэтому условие нереальное. После if нужен Past Simple (started).

prompt: Would Leah sleep better if the street light (not / to flicker) all night?
explanation_ru: Фонарь сейчас мигает, значит условие нереально. В if-части ставим Past Simple с отрицанием (did not flicker).

prompt: The chemist gives Johan some advice. 'If I (to be) you, I would rest before the flight.' Johan is happy. If he (to rest) well, he would feel better.
explanation_ru: Совет даётся через 'If I were you' — здесь всегда were. Второе условие нереально сейчас: Past Simple (rested) + would.

prompt: Bjorn works on roads all day, but at night he writes songs. 'If I (to leave) this job, I would play in a warm basement for a small audience,' he tells his guitar. 'And if those people (to like) my music, I would never stop writing.'
explanation_ru: Обе части — мечта, нереальная сейчас: в if-частях Past Simple, в результатах — would.

prompt: Matilda plans her friend's wedding in a village. 'If the weather (to be) warm, we would put the tables under the trees,' she says. 'And if everyone (to dance) until late, I would be the happiest person there.'
explanation_ru: После if с 'the weather' (it) допустимы и was, и were. В результате — would.

prompt: Timur writes to the manager: 'If my neighbours ___ quieter, I would sleep well.'
options: would be
are
were
will be
explanation_ru: После if нельзя ставить would/will. Для нереального настоящего нужен Past Simple — were (соседи — мн. ч.).

prompt: If the windows ___ better, Petar could sleep in this noisy room.
options: would close
closed
close
will close
explanation_ru: Окна сейчас закрываются плохо — условие нереальное. После if нужен Past Simple (closed), а не would/will.

prompt: Giulia would enjoy her pizza if the chef ___ it longer.
options: cooks
will cook
would cook
cooked
explanation_ru: Пиццу сейчас недопекают, поэтому условие нереальное. После if ставим Past Simple (cooked).

prompt: Gemma asks about the smaller town, and her friend says: 'If I ___ you, I would stay there a whole week first.'
options: were
was
would be
am
explanation_ru: В совете 'If I were you' всегда только were; was здесь неверно.

prompt: Diego cannot choose between two courses, so his friend says: 'I ___ the one with fewer essays if I were you.'
options: will choose
would choose
choose
chose
explanation_ru: Результат нереального условия передаётся через would + инфинитив (would choose), а не will или настоящее время.

prompt: If I would have a big parrot, it would be unhappy in my small flat.
answer: If I had a big parrot, it would be unhappy in my small flat.
accepted_answers: If I had a big parrot, it would be unhappy in my small flat.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — would после if (калька с «если бы»). В if-части нужен Past Simple: had.

prompt: Elif would be happier if visitors stop touching the mosaics.
answer: Elif would be happier if visitors stopped touching the mosaics.
accepted_answers: Elif would be happier if visitors stopped touching the mosaics.
explanation_ru: В нереальном условии после if нужен Past Simple (stopped), а не настоящее время.

prompt: Lorenzo would stay happy in the kitchen if the head chef gave him credit.
answer: Lorenzo would stay happy in the kitchen if the head chef gave him credit.
accepted_answers: Lorenzo would stay happy in the kitchen if the head chef gave him credit.
explanation_ru: Здесь ошибки нет: это правильное нереальное условие — Past Simple (gave) в if-части и would в результате.

prompt: Efe would feel safer if the council will add more lights to the rack.
answer: Efe would feel safer if the council added more lights to the rack.
accepted_answers: Efe would feel safer if the council added more lights to the rack.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — will после if. В нереальном условии (would в главной части) нужен Past Simple: added.

prompt: Ali's flight has landed late and the buses have stopped. A driver gives him advice.
options: If I were you, I would share a taxi with two other people.
If I was you, I will share a taxi with two other people.
If I am you, I would share a taxi with two other people.
I would share a taxi if I would be you.
explanation_ru: Совет даётся через 'If I were you' — только were, а в результате would.

prompt: Vikram works the front desk at a crowded city museum. He often thinks about a quiet little gallery by the sea.
options: If he works in a quiet gallery, he would feel calm.
If he worked in a quiet gallery, he would feel calm.
If he would work in a quiet gallery, he would feel calm.
If he worked in a quiet gallery, he will feel calm.
explanation_ru: Мечта о нереальном настоящем: после if — Past Simple (worked), в результате — would.

prompt: Artur cannot get his free coffee because the café is closed. → Artur would get his free coffee if
answer: Artur would get his free coffee if the café were open.
accepted_answers: Artur would get his free coffee if the café were open.
Artur would get his free coffee if the café was open.
Artur would get his free coffee if the café were not closed.
Artur would get his free coffee if the café was not closed.
Artur would get his free coffee if the café weren't closed.
explanation_ru: Обратная замена реальности на нереальное условие: после if допустимы и were, и was (café = it).

prompt: Sunita has to move the displays because the tent leaks. → If the tent did not leak,
answer: If the tent did not leak, Sunita would not have to move the displays.
accepted_answers: If the tent did not leak, Sunita would not have to move the displays.
If the tent did not leak, Sunita wouldn't have to move the displays.
If the tent didn't leak, Sunita would not have to move the displays.
If the tent didn't leak, Sunita wouldn't have to move the displays.
explanation_ru: Отрицательное нереальное условие: после if — Past Simple (did not leak), в результате — would not have to.

prompt: Mairi would sleep well if the machines were quiet.
options: The machines are not quiet, and Mairi does not sleep well.
The machines are quiet, and Mairi does not sleep well.
The machines are not quiet, and Mairi sleeps well.
The machines were noisy, and Mairi did not sleep well.
explanation_ru: В реальности турбины шумят и Мэри плохо спит. Условие меняет обе части на противоположные, время остаётся настоящим.

prompt: If Zainab rushed through the test, she would make mistakes.
options: Zainab does not rush, so she does not make mistakes.
Zainab rushes, so she makes mistakes.
Zainab does not rush, but she still makes mistakes.
Zainab did not rush, so she did not make mistakes.
explanation_ru: В реальности Зайнаб не спешит и не делает ошибок. Условие меняет полярность, но время остаётся настоящим.

prompt: If Chen lived in a mountain cabin, he would not hear the city traffic.
options: Chen lives in a cabin, so he does not hear the traffic.
Chen lived in the city, so he heard the traffic.
Chen does not live in a cabin, so he hears the traffic.
Chen does not live in a cabin, but he does not hear the traffic.
explanation_ru: В реальности Чэнь живёт в городе и слышит шум машин. Условие меняет полярность, время остаётся настоящим.

prompt: Match the halves.
pairs: If the market had more boxes,
the cleaners would have an easier day.
explanation_ru: Все половины образуют нереальное условие: Past Simple после if и would в результате; каждая левая часть подходит только к одной правой.

prompt: Build the sentence.
answer: If I were to lose my place, I would just carry on.
accepted_answers: If I were to lose my place, I would just carry on.
explanation_ru: 'Were to' обозначает маловероятное будущее; в результате — would + инфинитив.

prompt: Sort the sentences.

items.text: If I had a big balcony, I would relax there.
If Jacob saves money, he will buy a bigger flat.
I would grow plants if I had more sun.
If it is sunny, I will sit outside.
If the flat were bigger, Jacob would put a swing there.
If the flat is cheap, he will rent it.

explanation_ru: В 'Unreal now' — Past Simple после if и would в результате; в 'Real future' — Present Simple после if и will.
